english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for gripping or holding something firmly.
This is the all-purpose choice for physically gripping something tightly, such as a purse.

examples.english: I clench the handrail while waiting for the bus to stop.
examples.traditional: 我等緊巴士停低嗰陣，一路揸實扶手。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 gan2 baa1 si2 ting4 dai1 go2 zan6 jat1 lou6 zaa1 sat6 fu4 sau2

examples.english: I clutch my handbag when I take the bus so it will not get knocked down.
examples.traditional: 我搭巴士嗰陣揸實個手袋，費事畀人撞跌。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 baa1 si2 go2 zan6 zaa1 sat6 go3 sau2 doi2 fai3 si6 bei2 jan4 zong6 dit3
